answer: Run a leniency program, as antitrust regulators do with cartels. Seat earnings vest in escrow for 90 days. The first insider who proves a sybil ring, by signing one fresh challenge with keys from several seats, wins immunity plus half the ring's escrow as nectar; every other ring seat is slashed. Farms need hired operators, rented keys and shared hosts, so each partner fears a rival racing to confess. The oasis of easy fakes dries up once trust inside a ring is a river that can turn on you.
